title: Design principles
reason: All eight principles and expanded sections mapped: scientific purpose, nonmodal agency, data responsibility, familiar controls, responsive flexibility, hierarchy, bounded craft and useful delight. Confirmed accessibility/recovery/feedback gaps crosslinked.

title: Designing for games
reason: No game product. All five guidance subsections reviewed; defaults, responsive legibility, input alternatives and inclusive access transfer to general app categories. Controllers/avatar stories/Game Center/GameSave/haptics/spatial sound/game sensors N/A.

title: Designing for iOS
reason: Display/ergonomics/input/app switching and every best practice considered. Responsive/touch browser guidance applies; native widgets, Siri, payments, biometric/sensor feature opportunities N/A. Font and contrast gaps crosslinked; physical reach unverified.

title: Designing for iPadOS
reason: Display/ergonomics/multiple inputs/multitasking and all best practices considered. Adaptive nonmodal panels support large/compact screens. Native Apple Pencil/widgets and iPad binary on Mac N/A; preferred-font/accessibility gaps crosslinked.

title: Designing for iPhone Duo
reason: All Anatomy, Device poses, Best practices, Dynamic layouts, Reserved regions, Split views, Arrangement views, Vertical controls guidance reviewed. Current resizing preserves panel roots/drafts and overflow retains actions. Native arrangement/reserved-region/system vertical-bar APIs N/A to web implementation; folded hardware/safe regions unverified.

title: Designing for macOS
reason: Display/ergonomics/inputs/context and all best practices considered. Resizable panels and keyboard editing apply; system menus/window chrome are browser-owned. Native AppKit/Dock requirements N/A. Known data/recovery/preferences gaps crosslinked.

title: Designing for tvOS
reason: No native tvOS target. Display distance, remote/focus input, cinematic audio/art, multiuser and TV integrations all considered; general legibility/focus delegated to Foundations/Inputs.

title: Designing for visionOS
reason: No native spatial target. Space/immersion/passthrough/Spatial Audio/eye-hand/comfort/accessibility/safety and every best practice considered. Bloch scientific geometry is a 2D window feature; no SharePlay/spatial/immersive feature required.

title: Designing for watchOS
reason: No Watch target. Wrist display/ergonomics/Crown/Always On, quick actions, complications, notifications, sensors and independent Watch functionality all reviewed and N/A.

title: Getting started
reason: Category reviewed; nine leaf pages covered. Browser platform applicability recorded per leaf.
